season.title: Season
season.hint: There are four of them a year. Type the word for them.
season.how: Type `season` anywhere on the page (outside text fields) and pick a season in the picker with a click or 1 to 4. Typing `winter`, `spring`, `summer` or `autumn` switches one on directly; so does `season` in the shell, or five taps on the footer's last line on a phone. The weather stays until you reload; 0 in the picker turns it off.

konami.title: Konami
konami.hint: A cheat code older than most of the web. Arrows, then two letters.
konami.how: Anywhere on the page (outside text fields), press ↑ ↑ ↓ ↓ ← → ← → B A. Upper or lower case both work. The season picker opens.

mirror.title: Mirror
mirror.hint: Ask the shell to show you yourself.
mirror.how: In the shell, type `mirror` and allow the camera when the browser asks. It shows your camera as live, mirrored ASCII art; nothing leaves the tab. Esc closes it.

reel.title: Reel
reel.hint: Ask the shell for all the films at once.
reel.how: In the shell, type `reel`. Every project clip plays full screen, cut together with static. ← and → skip, Esc closes.

drop.title: Drop
drop.hint: The page takes more than clicks. Bring a picture.
drop.how: Drag a picture or video file from your computer onto the page and let go. It is turned into characters right in the browser, never uploaded. Mouse wheel or + and - change the resolution, C toggles colour, Esc closes.

singularity.title: Singularity
singularity.hint: Go somewhere nothing comes back from.

sudo.title: Sudo
sudo.hint: Ask for more rights than you have.
sudo.how: In the shell, type `sudo` (with anything after it) or `rm -rf`.

specimen.title: Specimen
specimen.hint: The typeface has a name. Say it.
specimen.how: Type `nexor` anywhere on the page (outside text fields), or `fc-list` in the shell. The site's own typeface opens as a specimen you can type into. Esc closes it.

screensaver.title: Screensaver
screensaver.how: Leave the page alone for 45 seconds with its tab in front: no mouse, keys, scrolling or touches.

dotfile.title: Dotfile
dotfile.hint: Some files do not show up in a plain listing.
dotfile.how: In the shell, `ls -a` lists a hidden file, `.plan`. Read it with `cat .plan`.

gravity.title: Gravity
gravity.hint: The name at the very bottom is not glued down.
gravity.how: Scroll to the very bottom and click the large name above the water. Its letters fall in; click again and they stand back up.

jump.title: Jump
jump.hint: Press on empty space, and do not let go.
jump.how: With a mouse: press and hold on empty space (not on text, links or buttons) for about a second without moving. A ring fills around the cursor; when it closes, the page jumps to the next section.

neofetch.title: Neofetch
neofetch.hint: Ask for the system info, the way people post it in screenshots.

source.title: Source
source.hint: Every code link has something to show. See all of them.
source.how: On a computer, in one visit: hover the `code` link of every project in All projects (a moment each is enough). Hovering `source` in Work counts too.

fortune.title: Fortune
fortune.hint: Ask the shell what the future holds.

console.title: Console
console.hint: Developers open a certain panel first.
console.how: Open the browser's developer console (F12, or ⌥⌘J on a Mac). The banner asks you to call `nexor()`: type `nexor()` and press Enter.

lightspeed.title: Lightspeed
lightspeed.how: Scroll very fast: two and a half screen heights within half a second, with a hard flick of the mouse wheel or trackpad, or a fast swipe on a phone.

snake.title: Snake
snake.hint: The game every old phone came with.
snake.how: In the shell, type `snake` and eat five `*`. Arrow keys or WASD, swipes on a phone; Q quits.

sculptor.title: Sculptor
sculptor.hint: On the start screen the cursor carves. Carve everything at once.
sculptor.how: With a mouse, on the start screen: sweep the cursor quickly back and forth through the big name until it is cut open in twelve places at once. Cuts heal after about two seconds.

whirl.title: Whirl
whirl.hint: On the start screen, draw circles around the name.
whirl.how: With a mouse, on the start screen: circle the cursor around the big name three full times within six seconds. It spins once on its axis.

stone.title: Stone
stone.hint: The water in the footer is flat enough to skip something across.
stone.how: Scroll to the very bottom and swipe the cursor or a finger quickly and level across at least a third of the water under the name. A stone skips across it.

vim.title: Vim
vim.hint: Open the editor everyone struggles to leave.
vim.how: In the shell, type `vim`, then leave with `:q` (or `:wq`, `:x`, `:qa`).

coffee.title: Coffee
coffee.hint: Ask for what keeps developers running.

hello.title: Hello
hello.how: Type `hello` anywhere on the page (outside text fields). The bar at the top says hello back.

wave.title: Wave
wave.hint: While the name is on screen, greet it from far away.
wave.how: Type `wave` anywhere on the page while the big name is on screen. Its 3D letters hop, one after another.

roll.title: Roll
roll.how: Type `roll` anywhere on the page. The camera does a barrel roll through the world.

lights.title: Lights
lights.hint: Type what you switch off before a film.
lights.how: Type `lights` anywhere on the page. The page goes dark and a torch follows the cursor; type `lights` again or press Esc to turn them back on.

zen.title: Zen
zen.hint: Type the word for a calm, empty mind.
zen.how: Type `zen` anywhere on the page. All text fades out and only the world is left; type `zen` again or press Esc to come back.
